purpose: A descriptive statistical profile of Qwen3-4B's refusal circuitry: per neuron, the correlation between its activation and whether the model refuses. A labeling DIMENSION (safety_corr) added to the inventory, like any other field - NOT ablation targets. Same descriptive method as the concept-neuron refusal literature (arXiv:2605.08513). The 4B's refusal is already mapped causally this session (r dial exp119/122); this characterizes WHERE the refusal signal lives and how diffuse it is at 4B. Disclosure measurement on an open-weights model.
battery: exp119 stimuli.prompts(): 288 everyday-wrongdoing requests with harmless one-word twins across 6 frames (real/hypothetical/roleplay/fiction/nested/depict). No weapons/drugs/CBRN/self-harm/sexual. Completions gitignored, never reproduced or served.

behavioral_axis.primary: full-generation refusal: 64 tokens greedy per prompt, refused = REFUSE regex in the first 200 chars (I can't/cannot/sorry/won't/unable/decline). This is the 'total behavior' label; first-token score is a known-weak proxy.
behavioral_axis.secondary: first-token refusal score: logsumexp(REFUSE first-token logits) - logsumexp(COMPLY first-token logits) at the reply onset (exp119 readout). Kept to MEASURE how far it diverges from the behavioral label, not as the primary.

activation: each neuron's down_proj-input activation at the LAST PROMPT TOKEN (the decision point), scaled by its corpus range.
fields: safety_corr[L,n] = point-biserial corr(activation, behavioral refused) over 288; firsttok_corr[L,n] = Pearson corr(activation, first-token score). Stored as arrays (safety_corr.npy).
writeup: AGGREGATE ONLY: per-layer mean |safety_corr| and count above threshold (where the refusal-correlated population concentrates); how diffuse at 4B (participation / top-k share of total |corr|); agreement between the behavioral and first-token correlations (the user's point, measured); the logit-lens tokens of the most refusal-correlated neurons (what they write). No per-neuron bypass claims; no ablation.
notes: Weights/forward + bounded generation for labels only; no steering toward compliance. Outputs gitignored.
